prompt: Stage 5-3, level 9 with 41 gold at 38 HP, four players left. Your board is a Blossom line: 2-star Ahri as the AP carry, 2-star Sett as the tank, Yunara and Master Yi as Blossom bodies. The shop shows Ashe (Blossom, Hunter, a physical-damage carry) and Draven (no shared trait, a physical-damage carry). You have no spare AD items. Which 5-cost do you buy?

options.label: Ashe: she replaces Caitlyn, adds a Blossom body for the next breakpoint, and her Hunter trait pairs with Caitlyn's if you keep both
Draven: the stronger standalone carry, so he raises the cap more
Neither: without AD items a 1-star 5-cost carry does nothing, so hold the gold

explanation:
A 5-cost at level 9 is judged by what it adds to the board that exists, not by its ceiling with items you do not have. Ashe is a Blossom unit: she advances the trait your whole board is built around, she can take Caitlyn's slot without losing a body, and a 1-star 5-cost with no items is still a better unit than a 2-star 2-cost. Draven with no items and no shared trait is a 1-star body that turns off a trait when he replaces someone.

'Neither' overcorrects: 5-cost bodies raise a level-9 board even naked, because their base stats and abilities are tuned for stage 5 while your 2-cost fillers are tuned for stage 2. The gold left after Ashe still rolls for her second copy at 15% odds, and every Ashe you see is one that the Blossom player on 71 HP does not get.
principle: Buy the 5-cost that improves the board you have; the ceiling is only worth chasing when the board is not yet capped.
commonMistake: Ranking 5-costs by their power with a full item set and buying the one your board cannot use.
